input.title: Men's Wolf – Lone Wolf. Early Bedtime. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

LONE WOLF. EARLY BEDTIME. This wolf zip up hoodie is for the guy who howls at the moon until about 8 p.m., worn to the campsite, the couch and the early night in.

On the back, a grey wolf curls up asleep on a flat rock under a patchwork quilt and a striped nightcap, a big full moon behind it like a night-light and pines fading out at the sides, under LONE WOLF. in heavy capitals above and EARLY BEDTIME. below. The lettering is cream and gold on Black and Navy and red and navy on Ash. On the front, a wolf face is embroidered on the left chest and the word 8PM is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest wolf and left-cuff 8PM, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Black, Navy, Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

Where are the print and the embroidery on this wolf zip hoodie?
The full sleeping wolf, moon and LONE WOLF. EARLY BEDTIME. lettering are printed across the back of this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, so the zipper never splits the art. On the front, a small embroidered wolf face sits on the left chest and 8PM is stitched on the left cuff.

Is it a good gift for a guy who goes to bed early?
Yes. It suits the lone wolf who is asleep by nine, the camper who calls it at dusk and anyone who loves a quiet night. Graphic Tees Co. makes each zip hoodie to order, includes one free size exchange within 30 days, and for Christmas you should order by about December 8.

How does the zip hoodie fit?
It is a regular unisex fit with a full metal zipper in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size, or go up one to layer it over a flannel. The fleece is 50% cotton and 50% polyester at 8 oz per square yard, warm enough for a cool campsite evening.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and fabric softener, and do not iron over the stitching. The wolf on the chest and the 8PM cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash.

What colors does it come in?
It comes in Black, Navy and Ash. The lettering is cream and gold on Black and Navy and red and navy on Ash, so every word stays clear, and the stitching is white thread on the dark colors and navy thread on Ash. Graphic Tees Co. makes each color to order.
